summary: The audit checks the 60 units: ILAC 136, 157 and 161 and one of ILAC 130 or 131 (4 units each), one of the core literature courses as the WIM, the ILAC 278A senior seminar, and electives from 100- and 200-level ILAC courses or up to three SPANLANG courses at the second-year level or above, not conversation courses. Every course must be letter graded, taken at Stanford, and not used for another major or minor. Checked by hand: the OPI, pre-approved Bing Overseas courses from Santiago or Madrid (up to 15 units) and outside courses (up to 5 units), and the honors thesis and colloquium.
